text: OpenAI MCP Extensions adds ChatGPT-specific capabilities to MCP so developers can build plugins that feel like native, first-class features. Install Bits & Bolts Remote . Select the Bits & Bolts icon in the sidebar to open the Parts Library . Open Extensions walkthrough to explore a demo of each major extension. Allow users to access your app from the sidebar. Render custom file viewers when users open a supported file type. Let users search your plugin’s resources from the composer and add references to a message. Let users select a CAD part using thumbnail choices. Ask @Plugin Creator in Codex to build a new plugin or improve an existing one for you. Notice any gaps in extensions for your plugin?
